about_the_game:
BloodBound Knights

A Roguelike Shoot 'Em Up Adventure Game

Overview :

BloodBound Knights is an intense rogue-like shoot 'em up where you take on the role of a powerful soldier. Unlock unique spells and upgrade your abilities in the shop to save yourself.

Key Features :

  • Choose Your Character

    Pick from a diverse cast of classes, each with their own unique magical or physical abilities. Whether you wield fire, ice, lightning, arcane energy or you just like to smash enemies, every character offers a different playstyle.

  • Fast-Paced Combat

    Engage in action-packed shoot 'em up combat. Dodge enemy attacks while unleashing powerful spells in dynamic, intense battles.

  • Level Up & Progress

    Gain experience, level up your character, and unlock stronger spells and abilities.

  • Unique Spells & Abilities

    Master spells and techniques that can be upgraded for devastating effects. Level up to unlock new powers and enhance your combat strategy.

  • Rogue-like Gameplay

    Experience procedurally generated levels with new challenges every time you play. No two runs are the same!

  • Shop System

    Gain gold by slaying enemies, defeating bosses and level upping, and buy powerful upgrades and buffs for your character.

    Gameplay Highlights :

  • Unlock new spells as you progress.

  • Actual abilities that you can cast, as well as automatic cast spells !

  • Face endless hordes of enemies and powerful bosses.

  • Enjoy rogue-like, procedurally generated levels.

  • Level up and grow stronger with every adventure.

  • Buy upgrades to enhance your character.
